description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class for managing credit bureau configurations within the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving, updating, and creating credit bureau data, mappings, and configurations, with security and serialization handling.

classes.name: CreditBureauConfigurationApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing credit bureau configurations, including endpoints for retrieval, creation, and updates, secured with user permissions.
